summary: International Money Express (IMXI) filed an 8-K updating its pending merger with The Western Union Company, announced August 10, 2025, under which Ivey Merger Sub, Inc. will merge into IMXI, leaving IMXI a wholly owned Western Union subsidiary. All required regulatory approvals are secured except California DFPI approval, suspended August 14, 2026 pending review, and Hart-Scott-Rodino clearance. Because the original HSR waiting period expired October 6, 2025, and clearance lapses after one year, both parties refiled Premerger Notification forms on October 2, 2026, starting a new 30-day period; early termination was requested. No price, premium, or closing date is stated.
